name: skeyes
notes: skeyes.be About us: 'skeyes is an autonomous public company in charge of the safety of air traffic in the civil airspace for which the Belgian State is responsible.' The former name Belgocontrol (from the repository README row) does not appear on the pages read, so the rename is not independently confirmed on an official page here. Logos are SVG files served by skeyes.be (tier 2, website-served): the teal colour logo with the 'nice to guide you' slogan (linked from the site's Media page) and the white version used in the home page header. The press room press.skeyes.be is a Prezly site whose logo is served from the Prezly CDN, so it was not used. No brand page or logo terms located, so redistribution rights are not confirmed.
